vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will have hats that are purple, red, brown and green. You will always be shown one either purple or red and the other brown or green. At some times purple and red give you the best advice, but when the numbers drop to 1 or 0 switch to the brown and green for advice.The most important thing is to make sure you hit the keys in time as you will get nothing if you are too slow.
